envelope.description: Relocate ConfigOption + CONFIG_CATALOG to src/config, leave a re-export shim

body.title: Relocate ConfigOption + CONFIG_CATALOG to src/config, leave a re-export shim
body.summary: Move the ConfigOption interface (src/cli/config-catalog.ts:23-28) and the 41-row CONFIG_CATALOG (src/cli/config-catalog.ts:30) verbatim into a new src/config/config-catalog.ts — no field added, removed or retyped, no catalog entry value changed, header comment carried over. Reduce src/cli/config-catalog.ts to `export { CONFIG_CATALOG } from '../config/config-catalog.js'` plus a `export type { ConfigOption }`, so the sole live importer (src/cli/command.ts:19, iterated at :337) compiles unchanged. The relocation is required, not cosmetic: src/daemon has zero imports of src/cli today, so the boot reconcile cannot reach the catalog from its current home without creating a new daemon→cli edge. The new file must import nothing from src/cli, preserving src/config's independence.
acceptanceChecks: src/config/config-catalog.ts is the single definition site of ConfigOption and CONFIG_CATALOG; the catalog still has 41 rows with the same paths, types, defaults and descriptions as before the move
src/cli/config-catalog.ts contains only re-exports and no declarations; the CONFIG_CATALOG it re-exports is reference-identical to the src/config one (no duplicated array literal)
src/cli/command.ts is unchanged and `npm run build` typechecks clean
src/config/config-catalog.ts has no import from src/cli

tests.name: relocated catalog parity — CONFIG_CATALOG still has 41 rows with identical paths, types, defaults and descriptions to the pre-move snapshot
re-export shim — src/cli/config-catalog.ts declares nothing and its CONFIG_CATALOG is === the src/config one; src/cli/command.ts's import resolves and typechecks unchanged
new definition site imports nothing from src/cli
